name: Lindie Oppermann
title: Clinical Psychologist, PsyBA Supervisor
description: Lindie has an interest in working with clients who struggle with anxiety and depression, grief and loss, adjustment and life transitions, and clients who are getting back on their feet after trauma. Works from CBT, ACT, narrative and solution-focused frameworks; provides therapy in English and Afrikaans. Works at Ringwood and Forest Hill clinics, including Saturdays.
specialties: Trauma, Grief and loss, Anxiety, Depression, Afrikaans

name: Jake Douglas
title: Psychologist
description: Jake draws upon CBT, ACT, schema therapy, and DBT skills. He works with teens to adults with concerns including depression, anxiety, stress management, relationship and communication difficulties, trauma, and more. Works at both Ringwood and Forest Hill clinics.

name: Lucy Chen
title: Psychologist
description: Lucy works with children, adolescents and adults managing complex mental health challenges. She provides trauma-informed, LGBTQIA+-affirming care that respects each person's culture and lived experience. Approaches include CBT, ACT and DBT skills, psychodynamic informed practice and EMDR Therapy. Special interests: trauma, neurodiversity, CALD, and LGBTQIA+ mental health.
specialties: Trauma, EMDR, LGBTQIA+ mental health, Neurodiversity, CALD

name: Nicholas Cooper
title: Psychologist
description: Nick supports clients who experience trauma, anxiety and stress disorders, mood disorders, ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, grief and loss, and sports-related issues, using psychoeducation, CBT and interpersonal therapy. Works at both Ringwood and Forest Hill clinics.

name: Melissa Rugbur
title: Psychologist
description: Melissa has a particular interest in working with adolescents and young adults, and is passionate about supporting clients through trauma. She is continuing to build her clinical toolkit with training in EMDR, Schema Therapy, and Internal Family Systems (IFS), delivering trauma-informed care. Works at both Forest Hill and Ringwood clinics.
specialties: Trauma, Adolescents, Young adults, EMDR (training), Schema Therapy, IFS

name: Akshay Dhingra
title: Psychologist (Counselling)
description: Akshay is passionate about counselling individuals and couples. He supports clients with anxiety, depression, self esteem, relationship stressors, stress, substance use, adjustment issues, trauma, grief and loss. Works at the Forest Hill clinic.

name: Emily Dwyer
title: Psychologist, Clinical Registrar
description: Emily has a particular interest in depression, anxiety, trauma, alcohol and other drug use, addictions, perfectionism, body image concerns, chronic pain, and personality disorders, drawing on ACT, CBT, DBT, and trauma-informed care. Works at both Ringwood and Forest Hill clinics.
specialties: Trauma, AOD, Body image, Personality disorders

name: Leah Brennan
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Leah is a Clinical Psychologist who works with adults, adolescents, children, and families. Leah takes an inclusive and affirming approach and is passionate about supporting LGBTQIA+ clients, including those exploring gender identity and expression. Works at both Ringwood and Forest Hill clinics.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, Gender identity and expression, Children, Adolescents, Families
